rich2021TaskDetails: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L18 concludes the year with pupils DESIGNING Which One Doesn't Belong investigations around 3D volume and then any mathematics. Source values derive from pictures and students' own drawings, not one fixed official four-choice result.

Warm-up Which One Doesn't Belong Volume presents original figures A/B/C/D, including source B as a described composite right-angled three-dimensional form with 7,2,1 and3 unit indicators. Other figure geometry is available only in source image assets; any exact missing source shape volume needs independent visual review rather than invented coordinates.
Activity1 Which One Doesn't Belong Design1: pupil selects THREE actual teacher-provided shape cards, draws ONE fourth shape, and explains ONE defensible reason EACH card could be excluded.

Activity2 Design2: student selects TWO cards and draws TWO new shapes, explaining for each of four shapes a meaningful distinction. Activity3 Design3 requires designing OWN four-card Which One Doesn't Belong on ANY grade-level math concept learned during the year.

Actual cards, original publisher images, four learner-drawn shapes and classification explanations need teacher visual review. The selected source Practice verifies the procedural number of cards and response rules only; no fake deterministic source figure classification is issued.
